name: 审核标准管理 - 编辑/启用/禁用操作
description: 在审核标准管理页面验证编辑标准弹窗结构、启用/禁用状态切换、必填字段、操作后列表更新。

steps.description: 打开审核标准管理页面

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tr[data-row-key]'); return { rowCount: rows.length, firstRowBtns: rows.length ? Array.from(rows[0].querySelectorAll('button, a, [class*=btn]')).map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [] }; })()
steps.description: 探查列表行数和操作按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const m=document.querySelector('.ant-modal,.ant-drawer,form'); if(!m) return {found:false}; const inputs=m.querySelectorAll('input,textarea'); const selects=m.querySelectorAll('.ant-select,select'); const switches=m.querySelectorAll('.ant-switch,[class*=switch]'); return {found:true, inputs:Array.from(inputs).map(i=>({placeholder:i.placeholder,value:i.value,type:i.type})), selectCount:selects.length, switchCount:switches.length, buttons:Array.from(m.querySelectorAll('button,.ant-btn')).map(b=>b.textContent.trim())}; })()
steps.description: 探查编辑表单完整结构

steps.contains: /(标准名称|规则名称|编辑|审核标准)/

steps.expression: (() => { const switches = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-switch'); const toggles = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=toggle],[class*=enable],[class*=disable]'); return { switchCount: switches.length, switchStates: Array.from(switches).map(s=>({checked:s.classList.contains('ant-switch-checked'),class:s.className.substring(0,50)})), toggleCount: toggles.length }; })()
steps.description: 查找启用/禁用开关组件

steps.expression: (() => { const sw = document.querySelector('.ant-switch'); if(sw) { const wasChecked = sw.classList.contains('ant-switch-checked'); sw.click(); return { clicked: true, beforeState: wasChecked ? 'enabled' : 'disabled' }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

realDomNotes: 审核标准管理 /review/standard-management；编辑可能为弹窗或行内编辑；启用/禁用通常为 AntD Switch 组件。
preconditions: F88预发环境可访问，测试账号已登录，当前身份为F88，至少存在一条审核标准
